experiments.name: Change Event Hub State
experiments.description: Changes selected Event Hub entities for a configured duration and restores each captured original state during rollback.

inputs.name: event_hubs
inputs.label: Event Hub Entities
inputs.hint: Use * for every Event Hub in the selected namespace, or enter a comma-separated list of entity names, for example orders, payments.

experiments.name: Disable Event Hubs Public Access
experiments.description: Disable namespace public access for the configured duration and restore its original setting during rollback.
